hpc help.output:
Use command as:

  > hpc  option

  option: 
          [AI|ai|hopper]            ==> to list instruction on AI & Deep Learning job submission and job monitor
          [dos|win|windows]         ==> to list instruction on common problem with Windows text file/program
          [pbs|PBS]                 ==> to list the common PBS job scheduling commands and flag options
          [gstat|q]                 ==> to list latest status of Hopper GPU cluster nodes and batch queues
          [project|proj] [date]     ==> to list the Name, Credits, Team Members, and End_date of Project(s)
          [project-usage]           ==> to list the project usage by members in a fixed time window.
          [quota|space|s]           ==> to list available disk space and quota limit
          [space --project]         ==> to list and check disk space usage and quota of CFP Project Folders.
          [space project=CFP04-*]   ==> to list and check disk space usage and quota of a CFP Project Folder.
          [how many GPUs can I use] ==> to list and check how many GPUs can use to run different sized jobs.
          [ssh access to GPU node]  ==> to list steps on ssh access to GPU node for debug/monitor of a running job.
